advices.title: Hypertension Dietary Advice
advices.instructions: Strict salt restriction (< 4g/day). Avoid fried, oily, and processed foods. Regular brisk walking 30 mins daily.

advices.title: Diabetic Foot Care
advices.instructions: Inspect feet daily. Keep feet clean and moisturized. Do not walk barefoot. Wear comfortable padded footwear.

advices.title: Post-Op Wound Care
advices.instructions: Keep incision clean and dry. Avoid lifting heavy weights for 4 weeks. Report fever or purulent discharge immediately.

advices.title: Hydration in Fever
advices.instructions: Drink plenty of oral fluids (ORS, coconut water, lemon water, boiled water). Take paracetamol as prescribed.
